novelty_basis: Every function M x M -> M is the feedback of a unique magma, so pair maps are exactly the order-2 feedback shift registers over n letters, and the criterion is the q-ary form of Golomb's nonsingularity condition (S. W. Golomb, Shift Register Sequences, 1967; see e.g. arXiv:1911.06670 for the binary statement and the correspondence of nonsingular registers with factors of the de Bruijn graph).
proof_check: Lean 4 + Mathlib (pairMap_injective_iff, pairMap_bijective_iff, mirrorMap_eq; standard axioms only); count by written proof (proofs/paper/C16.md Theorem 1) and exhaustive check n <= 4 (EXP-C16-01)
statement:
For a finite magma (M, *), the pair map P(a, b) = (b, b*a) of the recurrence x_{k+1} = x_k * x_{k-1} is a
bijection iff every left translation a -> b*a is a bijection; hence exactly (n!)^n of the n^(n^2) tables of
order n give permutations. The mirror recurrence x_{k+1} = x_{k-1} * x_k is the forward recurrence of the
opposite magma.
title: The Fibonacci pair map of a magma is a permutation iff every left translation is a bijection
